sasha: Quick thread to lock the rollout pattern for billing.routes.v1 -> v2. Customer-led launch, need conservative safety ladder and per-tenant rollback.
arjun: Proposal: banded rollout by tenant cohort (band A: 3 enterprise tenants, band B: 20 mid-market, band C: all others). Start with darklaunch + internal shadowing 24h.
maria: Health score idea: combine infra (error_rate, cpu), product (payment_success), and biz (conversion delta) into a single canary score 0-100. Abort if score drops >15 points vs baseline for 10m.
dave: Ops: require two 90m watch windows on launch day and one 3h window during peak for manual intervention. Add per-tenant circuit-breaker that can be tripped from console and via API.
sasha: Rollout phases: Phase 0 shadow 24h, Phase 1 band A 100% for 2h, Phase 2 band B staged to 10% over 12h, Phase 3 band C ramp to 25% over 48h then full over 72h if stable.
arjun: Feature flag model: region + tenant + band weight. Also mark flag states with metadata: paused_by, failed_at, health_score.
maria: Measurement gates: require canary score within 90% CI of baseline, no customer escalations, and downstream funnel delta < 0.5% before moving from Phase 2 -> 3.
dave: Kill-switch rules: immediate rollback if any single tenant sees >1% absolute drop in payment_success OR global error_rate >1% for 3m. Automatic fallback routes to billing.routes.v1 and marks tenants as excluded for 24h.
ops-bot: Automation note: will post automated health_score updates every minute and tag oncall on threshold breaches.
sasha: Owners: ops owns Phase 1; product+eng approve Phase 2. Named approvers will be in runbook RB-2026-128.
maria: I'll publish the experiment dashboard and wire the CI gate to block >25% until sample counts and tests pass.
arjun: We'll add a per-tenant "pause" toggle in admin and an API endpoint for partner ops. Security review required.
dave: Preflight checklist: shadow traffic runbook, smoke tests against v2, dashboards (health_score, p50/p95/p99, per-tenant success), alerts, approvers listed. Inhibit if infra CPU >75% or error budget low.
sasha: Timeline: target canary start Thu 08:00 PT. Next actions: RB-2026-128 draft, admin UI spec, flag PR, dashboard link. Posting canonical plan here. Ping me for changes. :white_check_mark:
